pages.text: Place the Distillery near a formed, charged altar. Add Blaze Powder as fuel, then the recipe ingredients. Its six ingredient slots and six output slots support complete recipe batches.

An operation takes ten working seconds and draws 20 altar power each second. Leave output space for every result. For Bottled Frostfire use a Glass Bottle, Perpetual Ice, Cleansing Balm and Fiery Unguent; receive the bottle and two Empty Jars. Iceworld brews can convert stone and leaves into Perpetual Ice.
